notes.title: 《双雄风流传》4月25日更新公告
notes.content:
[h1][b]功能增加[/b][/h1]
1.增加了因战斗 粮食 赋税等原因造成的居民压力增大
2.增加赋税调整功能，现在你可以调整征收赋税的数值
3.市场在战斗时间内物资会进行涨价
4.增加酒店食物和赌博导致的战斗行为BUFF，效果如下

清水白菜-无BUFF
清蒸草鱼-战斗力增加10%
芒果仙冰—战斗力增加20%
红烧鲤鱼-战斗胜利后士兵无损耗
海鲜拼盘-战斗力增加30%
蓝莓芒果冻-战斗胜利后压力减少增加10

[h1][b]数值修改[/b][/h1]
1.增加了不同战斗场景下的战斗数值
2.修正了过度的金币增加量
3.添加不同行为可能会导致的压力数值变化里，具体如下

居民压力计算 上限为100

[h2]2战斗结果[/h2]

战斗失败+20压力

[h2]3.战死士兵数量[/h2]
无战死士兵-10压力

战死士兵≥40  +4压力

[h2]4.粮食储备量[/h2]

notes.title: Game launch announcement
notes.content:
[b][h1]Overview[/h1][/b]
[b][h2]Preview Overview of the Launched Content[/h2][/b]:
[h3][King's Route][/h3] It will be released in the form of a visual novel game. Players can experience the intertwining of power and the insidious tracks as if they were on the scene. Every choice you make is related to the safety of the entire Daxia and yourself. The King's Route consists of a total of 12 chapters, with a word count exceeding 100,000 words. Currently, the first-round release is the content of the first two chapters. The subsequent articles have all been completed, and it will meet everyone as soon as possible after the art department finishes perfecting the interface.

[h3][Protagonist's Route][/h3] With business management and construction as the main gameplay form, players will play the role of a vassal king of a different surname at the border and build a border kingdom with their own hands, develop technology, and strengthen their strength. Overthrowing the current dynasty's rule in one fell swoop and ascending the throne by force is not really far away. All functions of the Protagonist's Route have been fully improved, waiting for you to explore. For players who are playing this type of game for the first time, they can go to the community to read the recommended beginner's guide.

[h3][Characters][/h3] Currently, at the initial launch, there are a total of 5 female protagonists accompanying the players. There are more than 30 other various NPC characters, bringing you an immersive experience.

[h3][Overview of Subsequent Updates][/h3]
1. Complete all content updates for the King's Route.
2. Listen to and modify some content and feedback according to players' opinions.
3. Launch subsequent free major update content.
